definitions.ask: Should the coder compile a scratch copy of the fix on the MacBook over Tailscale SSH before landing?

choices.label: Builds app, helper, and tests in a temp copy on `mac`; your checkout and installed app are untouched
Lands on Linux checks alone; macOS targets stay unverified until you rerun `just install`

definitions.why: Linux cannot type-check BobMacCapture, which is the target that broke `just install`

definitions.ask: Should the fix also add a `just portable-check` recipe and an AGENTS.md rule to compile Swift before landing?

choices.label: Adds one justfile recipe, two README sentences, and an AGENTS.md that `sase repo open` shows
Lands only the compile fixes; the next agent without Swift can ship uncompiled code again

definitions.why: The last four red CI runs all came from commits whose agents never compiled the Swift they changed
